questions.q: How do hosted LLM APIs generally charge for usage?
options: Per token sent (input) and per token generated (output), often with output priced higher
A flat fee per Python file
Per character in the API key
Only for failed requests
questions.explain: Pricing is usually quoted per million input and output tokens, and you should always check the provider's current price list.

questions.q: In the illustrative estimate, why did retrieving 8 chunks instead of 2 raise the cost per query?
options: The output became longer automatically
The API charges extra for the word chunk
Cosine similarity costs money
More retrieved text means more input tokens sent with every question
questions.explain: Retrieved chunks are pasted into the prompt, so more chunks means more input tokens per query. Sharper retrieval lets you send fewer.

questions.q: Which change most directly reduces both latency and cost for an extraction task?
options: Asking for a long, detailed explanation
Sending the whole database in every prompt
Asking for a short structured output such as a small JSON object
Adding more retrieved chunks
questions.explain: Generation time and output cost both grow with output length, so shorter outputs are faster and cheaper.

questions.q: What does the regex-based redact function in this lesson do, and what is its limit?
options: It guarantees full compliance with privacy law
It replaces obvious emails and phone numbers with placeholders, but only catches obvious patterns
It encrypts the prompt in transit
It removes the need to read the provider's data terms
questions.explain: Simple patterns are a useful first layer, not a compliance guarantee. Minimize what you send and check the provider's retention and training terms.

questions.q: The prices used in this lesson's code are:
options: Real current prices from a leading provider
Guaranteed minimum prices
Prices for local models only
Made-up illustrative numbers, so you must look up real pricing before budgeting
questions.explain: The lesson deliberately uses hypothetical tiers and prices. Real prices vary by provider and model and change often.
